label: Sub message
help: Used for subs, resubs and gift subs. Variables: {name}, {tier}, {months} (resubs), {count} (subs gifted), {message} (resub message).

label: Cheer message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 1,000 bits), {amount} (the number alone), {message}.

label: Raid message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 12 viewers), {amount} (the number alone).

label: Super Chat message
help: Variables: {name}, {amount} (with its currency, e.g. $5.00), {currency} (code, e.g. USD), {message}.

label: Kicks message
help: Variables: {name}, {amountText} (with its unit, e.g. 500 Kicks), {amount} (the number alone), {tier} (the gift's name, e.g. Rage Quit), {message}.
